tasks.label: Elmer: Run solver
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}/Elmer" && if command -v ElmerSolver >/dev/null 2>&1; then ElmerSolver dam_model.sif; else printf '%s\n' "ElmerSolver not found on PATH. Install Elmer or add it to PATH before running this task."; exit 1; fi
tasks.detail: Runs the Elmer solver against the local dam model and writes VTU output into the Elmer/results directory.

tasks.label: Elmer: Run combined solver
tasks.detail: Builds the combined mesh, runs the Elmer stress solver, and writes the result VTU into Elmer/structure_output/combined_solver/results.
